name: lift
description: Raises the element slightly, or grows it a little, and deepens its shadow while the pointer is on it or a keyboard is inside it.

attributes.name: data-lift
attributes.description: Which gesture: rise by --yeti-lift-distance, or scale by --yeti-lift-scale, for a tile in a row where a rise would break the line.

tokens.name: --yeti-lift-ease
tokens.description: The curve the lift runs on.

tokens.name: --yeti-lift-duration
tokens.description: How long the lift takes; match a tinted hover to it.

tokens.name: --yeti-lift-distance
tokens.description: How far the element rises; reduced motion takes it to zero.

tokens.name: --yeti-lift-scale
tokens.description: How much the element grows at data-lift="scale"; reduced motion takes it to one.

tokens.name: --yeti-lift-shadow
tokens.description: The shadow the element casts once lifted.

a11y.notes: The lift answers :focus-visible on the element and on anything inside it, so a reader tabbing through a page of cards sees the same affordance a pointer gets. It is decoration on top of a focus ring, never a replacement for one; the ring comes from the reset and is untouched. Under reduced motion the element no longer moves and the deeper shadow carries the hover by itself.
